items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I got involved in a big band once, through Eddie Condon. It was Joe Marsala's big band, at Loew's Nose as he called it, Loew's State Theatre.

ctx.x:
I got involved in a big band once, through Eddie Condon. It was Joe Marsala's big band, at Loew's Nose as he called it, Loew's State Theatre. And I've seen that big band. And I remember that saxophone section, after every show rehearsing. 29 shows, they rehearsed after every show, trying to get that break right.

It was a 32-bar tune, and at the end of the 29th bar, there was a two-bar break, and one of the saxophone players was supposed to come in. Now, if I may say, there was a beat like this, boop, and then he…

travel without my wife, so I got to pay the airfare both ways. I don't have any winter clothes, and it's winter. So I'm going to have to go -- and themore he thought about it, the more the answer came out no. And he told him no, it's not enough money.
